Property Taxes
Online Payments
Lincoln County has entered an agreement with Catalis GovPay for online property tax payments. This site is designed to provide you with additional methods to research your property information and to allow you to pay your property taxes online.
For an additional convenience fee (listed below) you may pay by ACH or credit card. If you own multiple properties, you may pay for them all in one transaction.
Payment Methods
| Convenience Fees
|
ACH - E-Check | $1.50 per Total Payment |
Credit Card - Discover / MasterCard / Visa / American Express (AMEX) | 2.4% per Total Payment
with a Minimum $1.50 |
Digital Payment System - PayPal & PayPal Credit with 6-month 0% Financing if approved | 2.4% per Total Payment with a Minimum $1.50
|
Convenience Fees will be combined with the Total Due.
If a refund is issued, we might not be able to reimburse any Convenience Fees.
|
Payments can take 3 - 5 Business days to process
|
If taxes are delinquent, you will be unable to pay online. Please contact the Treasurer’s Office for more information.
If you are experiencing issues with finding your property the parcel number will take you to the correct property. If you are using a street address and having problems try removing the directional indicator.
Example: 104 Main instead of 104 N Main St
Pay Property Taxes Online
Mail Payment
All mail payments must be postmarked by April 30th for the first half and October 31st for the second half to avoid interest. Mail payments can take up to 5 - 7 Business days to process.
Forms & Applications
Assessment freeze applications for the elderly and disabled need to be filed with the Treasurer's Office on an annual basis on or before April 1st. You must be 65 or older, or disabled on January 1st and meet the income guidelines to qualify. Household income includes all sources, including Veterans Assistance Benefits, Social Security, Medicare, and Disability payments. Please contact the Treasurer's Office at 605-764-5701 for more information on the income guidelines or to obtain a form.
The forms are also available to download through the South Dakota State website .
